searchText: ACDT in 30min, all links can be found here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1662#issuecomment-3154477823 Quick notes: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/all-core-devs-testing-acdt-48-aug-11-2025/25017/2#p-61028-acd-testing-call-48-aug-11-2025-quick-notes-1 Fusaka has PeerDAS and a few changes which sort of critical to keep L1/L2 scaling momentum going. ePBS/FOCIL, as good as it is for long term Ethereum goal and supporting other L1 scaling items, it does not have short-term impact. I doubt any App users will notice it even it is delayed by 1 year Actually, most of Glamsterdam as it is currently being planned (ePBS + BALs + repricings, though the latter haven't been formally discussed yet) is about scaling, and more radically so that any other previous fork I would say ePBS would theoretically enable something around a 1000% increase to the gas limit. Even a fraction of that would be noticeable to users Exactly, so if scaling post Glamsterdam is to a moderate 300M gas (3x over 100M post Fusaka), that’ll be noticeable. Plus ePBS lays the groundwork for proving, which gets us to 28G gas and beyond. Delaying that by a year will be noticeable.
